meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把生硬模板化的网文改写成自然顺口、有人味的文字
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用AI起草网文,想让成品读起来像真人手笔。
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite stiff, templated web fiction into natural, human-sounding prose
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you draft web fiction with AI and want it to read like a human wrote it.

howto.what: 检测网文里的 AI 写作痕迹（禁用词、句式套路、情绪空转等），按轻/中/重度分级，再逐句改成更自然的口语表达，最后给出修改前后对比和润色报告。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-deslop、/去AI味 等命令，或说“这篇太AI了”“去AI味”时触发；也可以只让它检测、不改原文。

say.text: 帮我去AI味，把这段网文改自然点。
say.note: 走检测、分级、改写全流程

say.text: 检查下这章有没有AI味，只标注不要改。
say.note: 只输出问题标记表，不动原文

say.text: 这篇AI味挺重的，按重度处理。
say.note: 用完整 7 Gate 并重写重点段落

howto.what_en: Detects AI writing tells in web fiction — banned words, formulaic sentences, hollow emotion — grades the text light/medium/heavy, rewrites sentences to read more natural, and reports the changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /story-deslop or /去AI味, or say the passage reads too AI. Detection-only, no-edit mode is also available.

say_en.text: De-slop this passage and make the web fiction read natural.
Check this chapter for AI tells, flag only, don't edit.
say_en.note: Outputs a problem table, leaves text untouched

say_en.text: This one is heavy on AI tells — treat it as heavy.
say_en.note: Uses all 7 gates plus key-paragraph rewrites
